meta.title: Affiliate Program
meta.description: Join the SkelApp affiliate program and earn bonuses for referring growing retailers and modern businesses.

hero.copy: Earn bonuses by referring businesses to SkelApp. If your audience trusts your recommendations, you can turn that trust into a practical revenue stream with a point-of-sale system built for modern commerce.
hero.note: Approved partners receive portal access and referral support from our team.
hero.image_alt: SkelApp merchants using a tablet together

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Share your contact details
steps.copy: Start with your name, company, and the best way for us to reach you.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Tell us about your audience
steps.copy: Show us how you support business owners, operators, or merchants in your network.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Get approved and onboarded
steps.copy: We review the fit, align on the program, and share your affiliate setup details.

steps.label: Step 4
steps.title: Refer businesses and earn
steps.copy: Send qualified referrals, help them discover SkelApp, and earn bonuses as they get started.

referrals.copy: From boutiques and beauty stores to grocery, hardware, and specialty retail, SkelApp helps businesses sell faster, stay in control of stock, and grow with confidence.

partners.title: Built for partners who already influence commerce.
partners.copy: If you teach, publish, advise, or supply tools to business owners, the SkelApp affiliate program gives you a clear way to recommend software people can actually put to work.

cards.title: Creators
cards.copy: Share SkelApp in your videos, demos, communities, and social content.

cards.title: Course Makers
cards.copy: Include SkelApp in workshops, training programs, and business tutorials.

cards.title: Content Publishers
cards.copy: Publish buying guides, comparisons, newsletters, and practical business explainers.

cards.title: Commerce Experts
cards.copy: Recommend SkelApp during advisory work, implementation support, or digital transformation projects.

cards.title: Hardware Vendors
cards.copy: Pair SkelApp with devices, setup services, and the retail hardware you already provide.

cta.title: Become a SkelApp affiliate partner
cta.copy: Help retailers in your network sell better, stay on top of inventory, and run with more confidence. We will help you get set up and ready to refer.
